\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  30 & 30 & 220 \\
  30 & 220 & 220 \\
  80 & 220 & 30
\end{bmatrix}
\]

The value 30 occurs 4 times, 220 occurs 4 times and 80 once. 30 and 220 tie, and the smaller value wins, so the output is **30**. The median of the same window is 80.
